versions.changelog: Reduce ClawScan surface by making the skill no-code: remove bundled helper scripts, credential writer, endpoint override, and MCP client while retaining approval-first Buffer workflow guidance.
Harden ClawScan posture: remove endpoint override support, add explicit mutating-call approval flag, and document credential/security model.

Address ClawHub security review: remove setup-time child_process use, replace auto-config script with a no-command secret storage helper, add homepage provenance metadata, and keep explicit write-approval guardrails
Initial Buffer MCP skill with Streamable HTTP client, simple OpenClaw SecretRef setup, and safe social publishing workflow
